Definition: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent:--+ began to amend.
BiblicalUsage: Kompsoteron means better, more nicely, and here it means convalescent, beginning to amend. John 4:52 has the nobleman asking the hour when his son began to amend, and the servants answering, yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hour is the proof: the fever left at the seventh hour, the very hour Jesus said, thy son liveth, and the father's faith began when the fever ended.
